name: Spiritual Energy
overview: Spiritual energy, as revealed in Scripture, is sustained and renewed through a deep, abiding relationship with God. Trusting fully in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding empowers believers to persevere without weariness, as those who wait upon the Lord will renew their strength and soar like eagles. This vitality flows from abiding in Christ, the true vine, whose presence enables fruitful living, while meditating on God's Word day and night guides our steps toward success. Ultimately, worshiping God in spirit and truth connects us to the divine source of life, made possible through the sacrificial love of Christ.
